new_API_blocks.label: spacr.embeddings.EmbeddingSpec#1
new_API_blocks.source: For ``subcell_rybg``, choose :data:`CHANNEL_PROJECT`, supply four explicit, distinct ``channels`` in microtubules (R), ER (Y), DNA (B), protein (G) order, and set ``normalize=False``. Crops must be at least 16 pixels in each spatial dimension. Native dimensions are preserved; the encoder applies the authors' whole-crop min-max normalization.

new_runtime: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains. SubCell's two-plane model takes DNA then protein; its four-plane model needs explicit microtubules, ER, DNA and protein mapping. Weights download once. Cell-DINO needs an official checkpoint and is not yet supported by this version. Default None (use the backbone).

OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains; SubCell takes two, DNA then the stain of interest, in the order the channels are encoded. Weights download once.
